responsibility: Implements entry-point support for the `custom_mir` attribute by creating an injected MIR body, parsing the attribute-selected MIR phase, setting up parsing context and body scaffolding, and dispatching THIR-based custom MIR parsing through the custom parse submodule.
same_name_distinction: Among the crate's `mod.rs` files, this one is not a general module hub: it is the specialized entry for `custom_mir`, building an injected MIR body and invoking the custom parser instead of owning ordinary THIR construction, standard MIR building, pattern lowering, or match lowering.
